name: Auto Materials
author: Tequila
description: Puts library materials on parts by their names when a model comes in: screws get steel, lenses glass, grips rubber. Your own rules, or the whole scene at a click.

commands.title: Auto Materials…
commands.description: Edit the rules, and apply them

commands.title: Apply the rules to every part

fields.label: Rules, one a line - words in a part's name: library material
fields.default:
screw, bolt, nut, washer, rivet, standoff: Stainless Brushed
glass, lens, window: Glass Clear
rubber, grip, foot, feet, gasket, seal, tyre, tire, o-ring: Rubber Black
chrome: Chrome
leather, strap: Leather Black
screen, display, lcd: Screen Glow

fields.label: Or rules from a CSV file (words, material)
Apply them when a model is imported
